text:
Diego (Design): Quick sync: reduce badge noise, make pinning explicit. Current problems: legend too tall, badges steal attention, pinned state unclear. Thoughts?
Ava (PM): Make pin CTA say "Pin version to compare". Add persistent row label like "Comparing: v2-quant" when pinned.
Sam (Frontend): I'll prototype a compact chip: icon + 2-char label with full text on tooltip/focus. Add focus-visible and non-color indicators.
Marta (A11y): Ensure tooltip reachable by keyboard and announced. Use aria-describedby + aria-live for pin changes: "Pinned v2-quant for comparison." Include sr-only text in badges.
Priya (Eng-ML): Backend should persist pinned_variant_id per account. API: POST /catalog/models/:id/pin { pinned_variant_id }
Diego (Design): Legend heading -> "Performance profile" + microcopy "Latency · Cost · Quality (hover for numbers)". Hide by default behind a chevron to save space.
Ava (PM): Scope pinning to account for now; research asked for per-project later. Add telemetry: legend_toggled, badge_hover, pin_toggle.
Sam (Frontend): Will add keyboard screenshots and telemetry to ticket. ETA prototype: 48h. 
Priya (Eng-ML): I'll draft API + migration notes for cache hints for Dedicated customers.
Marta (A11y): Add undo toast that's keyboard accessible and announces on screen readers.
Diego (Design): I'll drop mocks in thread tomorrow.
Ava (PM): I'll file the product ticket with acceptance criteria: accessible tooltips, persisted pin, compact legend toggle, telemetry.
Sam (Frontend): :+1:
